name: Atal Pension Yojana
summary: A guaranteed pension scheme for unorganised sector workers, providing a fixed monthly pension between Rs. 1000 and Rs. 5000 after the age of 60, depending on the contribution chosen.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
summary: A placement-linked skill development programme for rural poor youth that provides free training in employable trades and guarantees placement in wage employment or self-employment.

name: eShram (National Database of Unorganised Workers)
summary: A national registry of unorganised workers, including migrant and gig workers, that issues an eShram card and links workers to social security and welfare benefits.

name: Integrated Child Development Services
summary: An early childhood care and development programme delivered through Anganwadi centres, providing supplementary nutrition, immunisation, health check-ups, referral services and pre-school education to children below six years and to mothers.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
summary: Monthly pension for persons aged 18 years and above with severe or multiple disabilities (80% or more) belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
summary: Monthly pension for persons aged 60 years and above belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households. Higher amount for persons aged 80 years and above.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
summary: Monthly pension for widows aged between 40 and 79 years belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households. Enhanced amount for widows aged 80 years and above.

name: Jal Jeevan Mission
summary: A mission to provide every rural household with a functional household tap connection supplying adequate and safe drinking water in usable quantity on a regular basis.

name: Kisan Credit Card
summary: A credit scheme that gives farmers timely and hassle-free access to institutional credit through a Kisan Credit Card, covering crop cultivation, allied activities and consumption needs.

name: Pradhan Mantri POSHAN Shakti Nirman (Mid-Day Meal)
summary: A school nutrition programme that provides hot cooked meals to children studying in classes one to eight in government and government-aided schools, improving enrolment, attendance and nutrition.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
summary: Guarantees at least 100 days of unskilled wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
summary: A scheme that provides collateral-free loans to non-farm micro and small enterprises through banks, NBFCs and microfinance institutions under the Shishu, Kishore and Tarun categories.

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission
summary: A livelihoods mission that organises rural poor households, especially women, into self-help groups and provides capital, credit and skill support to raise household incomes.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
summary: Scholarship for SC/ST students studying in Classes 9 and 10, covering admission fees, tuition fees and a monthly maintenance allowance, subject to parental income limits.

name: Public Distribution System (National Food Security Act, 2013)
summary: Provides subsidised foodgrains to eligible households through Fair Price Shops under the National Food Security Act, 2013. Priority Households (PHH) and Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) families receive monthly entitlements.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
summary: Financial assistance for construction of pucca houses with basic amenities for eligible rural households that are houseless or living in kutcha/dilapidated houses.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban)
summary: An urban housing mission that provides central assistance and interest subsidy to economically weaker sections and lower income groups to enable them to build or buy a pucca house.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
summary: A credit-linked subsidy programme that supports the setting up of micro-enterprises in manufacturing and service sectors, generating self-employment opportunities in rural and urban areas.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
summary: A crop insurance scheme that provides comprehensive risk cover to farmers against natural calamities, pests and diseases from pre-sowing to post-harvest, at a very low share of premium.

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises
summary: A scheme that provides credit-linked subsidy, branding and marketing support to micro food processing enterprises to help them formalise, upgrade technology and grow.

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
summary: Health insurance providing cover of Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation to eligible poor and vulnerable families.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
summary: A financial inclusion mission that provides every household with a basic zero-balance savings bank account, a RuPay debit card, an overdraft facility and accident insurance cover.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
summary: A life insurance scheme offering cover of Rs. 2 lakh for death due to any reason, available to bank account holders in the age group of 18 to 50 years for a nominal annual premium.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
summary: Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year to eligible landholding farmer families, paid in three equal instalments of Rs. 2,000 every four months.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
summary: A voluntary contributory pension scheme for small and marginal farmers that provides a assured monthly pension of Rs. 3000 after the age of 60.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan
summary: A solar energy scheme that provides subsidised standalone solar pumps and solarisation of existing agriculture pumps to farmers, giving reliable irrigation and an additional source of income.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
summary: A maternity benefit scheme that provides a cash benefit of Rs. 5000 to pregnant and lactating mothers for their first living child, to partly compensate for wage loss and to promote health-seeking behaviour.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
summary: Financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying at the post-matriculation level. Includes maintenance allowance (hosteller/day-scholar) and reimbursement of non-refundable fees, subject to parental income limits.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
summary: An accidental death and disability insurance scheme offering cover of Rs. 2 lakh for accidental death or total disability and Rs. 1 lakh for partial disability, for a nominal annual premium.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
summary: Provides a free LPG cooking gas connection, with the first refill and a stove, to adult women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) households so that clean cooking fuel replaces firewood and other unhealthy fuels.

name: PM Vishwakarma
summary: A scheme that supports traditional artisans and craftspeople with skill training, modern toolkits, collateral-free credit and market linkages to improve the quality and reach of their products and services.

name: Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin)
summary: A rural sanitation mission that provides a financial incentive to Below Poverty Line households in villages to construct and use an individual household toilet.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
summary: A small savings scheme for a girl child below 10 years of age, offering an attractive fixed interest rate and a tax-free maturity amount that can be used for her education or marriage.

name: Stand-Up India
summary: A scheme that facilitates bank loans to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and women entrepreneurs for setting up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, trading and allied agricultural activities.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
summary: A micro-credit scheme that provides collateral-free working capital loans to urban street vendors to help them resume their livelihoods, with interest subsidy and digital cashback on repayments.
